content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(EDR-008 Rapid Mass File Rewrite With Uniform New Extension) AND (BIOC(EDR-008 Ransom Note Written Across Multiple Directories) OR BIOC(EDR-008 Local Recovery Inhibition — Snapshot Or Backup Deletion)) — fuses the encryption, ransom-note, and recovery-inhibition stages from one host into a single critical Impact incident.
rules.name: Ransomware — Linux Host Mass-Encryption + Recovery Inhibition (Same Host)
